name: Multivariable Calculus
description: Extend calculus to several inputs: gradients, constrained optima and double integrals.

requires.why: Uses the product, quotient and chain rules in partial derivatives and the multivariable chain rule.
Reads the gradient as a vector and gets directional derivatives with the dot product.
Evaluates double integrals as repeated integrals using substitution and improper integrals for e to the minus x squared.

lessonNames.l4-chain-two-inputs: The chain rule with two inputs
lessonNames.l10-second-derivative-test: Classifying with the second derivative test
lessonNames.l16-bell-curve-area: Why the bell curve integrates to one

lessonObjectives.l1-two-inputs: Read a function of two variables as a surface and as a contour map.
lessonObjectives.l2-slicing: Compute partial derivatives by holding one variable fixed.
lessonObjectives.l3-second-partials: Compute second and mixed partial derivatives.
lessonObjectives.l4-chain-two-inputs: Apply the multivariable chain rule along a path.
lessonObjectives.l5-steepest-climb: Compute the gradient and see it point uphill, across the contours.
lessonObjectives.l6-any-direction: Compute a directional derivative from the gradient.
lessonObjectives.l7-tangent-planes: Approximate a surface near a point with its tangent plane.
lessonObjectives.l8-walking-downhill: Minimise a function with gradient descent in code, and choose a step size.
lessonObjectives.l9-peaks-pits-saddles: Find the stationary points of a function of two variables.
lessonObjectives.l10-second-derivative-test: Classify stationary points with the Hessian.
lessonObjectives.l11-on-a-constraint: Use a Lagrange multiplier to optimise along a constraint curve.
lessonObjectives.l12-min-variance: Find the minimum variance two-asset portfolio with a Lagrange multiplier.
lessonObjectives.l13-volume: Evaluate a double integral over a rectangle as repeated integration.
lessonObjectives.l14-other-regions: Set up a double integral over a region with curved edges.
lessonObjectives.l15-polar: Evaluate a double integral in polar coordinates.
lessonObjectives.l16-bell-curve-area: Evaluate $\int e^{-x^2}\,dx$ by squaring it and switching to polar coordinates.
lessonObjectives.l17-stretching-the-grid: Change variables in a double integral with the Jacobian determinant.
lessonObjectives.l18-three-inputs: Evaluate a triple integral over a box and a simple solid, and use spherical coordinates for a ball.
lessonObjectives.l19-many-constraints: Optimise a function of three variables under one or two constraints, such as portfolio variance at a target return.
lessonObjectives.l20-edges-count: Find the absolute maximum and minimum on a closed region by checking the interior and the boundary.
